name: handy
description: Real-time native mouse, keyboard, window, clipboard, and coordinate-mapped screen control for LLMs.
long_description: Handy lets agents and LLMs natively control a computer's mouse, keyboard, clipboard, and desktop windows in real-time — including multi-step chained actions such as focus_window, move, click, paste, and smart visual waits (wait_for_change / wait_for_settled / wait_for_color) in a single call, plus window-relative coordinates — while seeing the live screen or a single window annotated with dual-contrast mapped (x, y) coordinates, numbered action trails, active window info, pixel hex under cursor, and frame-to-frame visual diffs (highlightDiff). Includes an instant on/off permission toggle, live SSE web Control Panel, and top-left (0,0) corner-slam failsafe.

enabled.title: Enable Computer Control (On/Off)
enabled.description: Master permission toggle allowing LLMs to view the screen and control mouse and keyboard.
